verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide lists user call-handling features, including call handling configurations, state-based rules and call forwarding targets. Its plan pages mention call queues with "better routing" and visual voicemail. Together these suggest routing calls to other numbers or voicemail, but nothing explicitly documents ringing a group in order or at once, or handling unanswered calls. missing for 10: explicit sequential vs simultaneous group ring documentation, explicit no-answer rule routing to voicemail or an external number, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number
